face_policy: Every new ordinary action uses an original-drawn dark face with eyes hidden. Only v4 eye/recognition source-art closeups reveal the face.
anchor_note: Source-pixel manually inspected points, typically +/- 10-20 px. Eye iris +/-3px. Back pen alpha endpoint measured. No invisible eye anchor or mirroring.

earlyCircle.note: Complete connected shoulder, elbow and right stylus hand. Torso intentionally exits source left/bottom. Pen anchor is the visible purple tip (source luminance/alpha inspected), not the almost-black outer antialias tip at 1577,553. No mirrored placement.

earlyTangent.note: Distinct high three-quarter writing grip, vertical stylus. Complete shoulder/arm context; source-pixel anchors manually inspected.

earlyTravel.note: Connected reaching shoulder/arm with right index finger. The pen alias denotes finger contact, no physical pen in this asset. Timeline props removed by ImageGen edit.
